sentence: The gravest violations were seen in Al-Shabaab held areas, including in Middle and Lower Juba where the Monitoring Group documented an increase of child recruitment from early 2015.81 This included situations where whole villages were forced to render their children and young men (or pay for an exemption) and where young boys ‘disappeared’ en masse from Al-Shabaab madrasas.82 Across the border in Kenya the Monitoring Group received reports of radicalisation and recruitment through madrasas in the refugee camps.83 Children were used both in support functions and in direct operations, including incidents where explosive devices were used.84 55.
